svg.title: A 2-1 buydown
svg.desc: On the reference loan, a 2-1 buydown makes the payment $954.83 in year 1 and $1,073.64 in year 2, then $1,199.10 from year 3. A subsidy of $4,436.76 covers the difference.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'Segoe UI', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Year 1 paid as if at 4%, year 2 at 5%, then the note rate of 6%. A subsidy covers the gap.
